killproc() {

#!/bin/sh
#
# help-site       Legacy help content and permanent URL migration
#
# chkconfig: 2345 85 15
# description: Serves the staged help tree on TCP port 8080.
# processname: help-site.py
# pidfile: /var/run/help-site.pid

. /etc/init.d/functions

prog=/usr/local/sbin/help-site.py
pidfile=/var/run/help-site.pid
lockfile=/var/lock/subsys/help-site
logfile=/var/log/help-site.log

start() {
    printf 'Starting help-site: '
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; then
        success
        printf '\n'
        return 0
    fi
    rm -f "$pidfile"
    touch "$logfile"
    chown nobody:nobody "$logfile"
    "$prog" --daemon
    rc=$?
    sleep 1
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$pidfile" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; then
        touch "$lockfile"
        success
        rc=0
    else
        failure
        rc=1
    fi
    printf '\n'
    return "$rc"
}

stop() {
    printf 'Stopping help-site: '
    killproc -p "$pidfile" "$prog"
    rc=$?
    rm -f "$pidfile" "$lockfile"
    printf '\n'
    return "$rc"
}

case "$1" in
    start)
        start
        ;;
    stop)
        stop
        ;;
    restart|reload)
        stop
        start
        ;;
    status)
        status -p "$pidfile" "$prog"
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'Usage: %s {start|stop|restart|status}\n' "$0"
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
exit $?
